title: Old-time carnival, masking and dancing with a man in drag
summary: Talk of how carnival used to be with masks and bands, including a dance with a man dressed as a woman.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: They don't have any more carnival, you know. The carnival we had was so much different than the carnival now. Oh, yeah.

The culture with masks and all, they had good bands and good parades and everything. They don't have no carnival. No, they don't have no carnival. People want to go out and worry about carnival mostly for kids. No carnival. They sang, they danced, they danced. They sang carnival, no.

I mean, those days it was carnival. They do their best on carnival. I mean, everybody, nobody, nobody, nobody went to the street with our mask. Nobody went to the street with our mask. And they didn't want to do under that mask.
Yeah, sure. They danced and play a joke on people, you know. That's right.
Women, you know, get out and boy, you ain't no good, you ain't no good, you ain't no good, you know, so-and-so-and-so. And they go about a business.

But who was that? Who was that? You know what I mean? Come to my room or something, give him a key. And he thought, sure, he was going to that garage room. And he wasn't going nowhere because he just had those keys delivering them around to all of us. They had fun. It was really fun, you know. And the fellas would dance, mask like a woman, dress up like a woman.
Yeah, dress up like a woman.
And they danced with the men and the men would buy him a whole lot of drink.

I mean, I danced with a guy one night at the Columet Hall and I thought he was a girl. Really? All night long. I didn't get angry, there was nothing to get angry about, you know. Some people, you know, in a fight, want to shoot you, you know. I mean, no, but, no, that wasn't.

That's what happened when my daddy got shot. He didn't want to say, but that's what happened. A fella was dressed up as a woman dancing with another fella. And when the fella, he was a woman, a man, he started to fight and that's when he shot him, when he was trying to get away from him.
Yeah. What would they sing? Huh? What would they sing? Sing all kinds of French songs, Creole songs and all. Oh yeah, Creole songs. Do you know any of them? Uh-uh.
